This document details the upcoming trial of Sam Bankman-Fried (SBF) regarding the collapse of FTX and Alameda Research, highlighting Michael Lewis's book 'Going Infinite' which chronicles SBF's rise and alleged attempts to buy off Donald Trump with a $5 billion offer.
